About Norton Ghost

Norton Ghost is one disk imaging and cloning tool that firstly developed in the 1990s. It can help you make backup images of the whole hard disk, selected partitions or only those files that mean the most to you. When something goes wrong, Norton Ghost can restore your computer to previous functional status . Besides, it can also help you clone one hard drive to another hard drive.

In a word, if you want to make an image back for your computer or want to clone to the new hard drive, Norton Ghost is not a bad choice. However, now Norton Ghost is no longer available for the Home user. It was discontinued by Symantec in 2013. Indeed you can still download the latest version - Norton Ghost 15, but it only offers a 30-day free trial and then you need to pay for it.

Here in this guide, you will get the detailed steps about how to use Symantec Ghost in Windows 11/10/8/7. You can simply search “Norton Ghost 15 download” via your browser to get the tool. Image Your Computer with Norton Ghost

1. Install Norton Ghost and open it. It will run a step-by-step wizard the first time you open it. At last, you will see the Easy Setup interface where you can create a backup at once. You can also click the Cancel option and set the backup task later.

2. On the Home screen, you can create a backup task by clicking Define Backup Wizard or Run or Manage Backups. Here we choose the latter one.

3. The Easy Setup screen will appear.

  • You can click OK to accept the default settings or click a setting to modify it.
  • Or you can click Custom… to create a backup according to your needs.

4. Finally, click OK to confirm.

Restore Image with Norton Ghost

Click Recover My Files if you want to recover files or folder, or Recover My Computer to make it.

Recover My Files:

1. On Recover My Files screen, you can find the files you want to restore through File and Folder & Recovery Point.

2. Whichever you choose, you can type the file name you need in the box under Find files to recover and click Search to find it.

3. After the scanning, select the file you need and click Recover Files…

Recover My Computer:

On Recover My Computer screen, find and choose the right system restore point and click Recover Now to make it.

👉 Note: If your computer cannot run Windows normally, you can use the Symantec Recovery Disk CD to help you boot your computer. Depending on which version of the product you have purchased, Symantec Recovery Disk is either included on your product CD or as a separate CD. If you don’t have a floppy drive, you can create a Norton Ghost Bootable USB instead.

Clone Disk with Norton Ghost

1. Connect your new hard drive to your computer.

2. On the Tools page, click Copy My Hard Drive and follow the steps in the wizard to copy the drive.

👉 Note: The drivers that are used to run the hardware on one computer will likely not match the drivers on a second computer. So you’d better not use the Copy Drive feature to set up a hard drive that will be used in another computer.

FAQs about Norton Ghost

1. Is Norton Ghost still available?

Answer: Norton Ghost was officially discontinued by Symantec in 2013. This means that it is no longer available for purchase, and no new updates or official support are provided.

2. Can I still use Norton Ghost on my current system?

Answer: While you can still use Norton Ghost on your system, it may face compatibility issues with newer operating systems and hardware due to its discontinuation and lack of updates.

3. What should I do if I encounter issues with Norton Ghost?

Answer: Since Norton Ghost is discontinued and no longer supported, finding official assistance may be difficult. You might try searching for solutions in user forums, community support sites, or using alternative backup software that is actively supported.

4. How do I migrate my data from Norton Ghost to another backup solution?

Answer: To migrate your data, you can restore your backups created with Norton Ghost to your system and then use another backup solution to create new backups. Alternatively, some backup tools might allow importing Ghost backup files directly.

Step-by-Step Optimization Techniques for Windows 10/11 Users on DEX, LYRX, or PCDJ Systems

The optimizations below are suggested for users employing DEX 3 , DEX 3 RE , or LYRX on computers running Windows 10 or 11. Regardless of your computer’s power or age, following these recommendations can enhance performance.

For supported operating systems and to ensure your device’s specifications are adequate, please check the DEX 3 , DEX 3 RE , or LYRX System Requirements.

To implement several optimizations, access the Control Panel by:

  1. Pressing the Windows Key or clicking the Start button.
  2. Typing “Control Panel.”
  3. Pressing Enter or selecting the Control Panel app.

Optimization and Power

  • Restart your computer.
    • Regularly rebooting your PC can prevent issues like audio glitches, crashes, and system hangs. Before significant events, always restart your system.
  • Always connect your power adapter.
    • Running DEX 3 or similar software solely on battery can cause CPU throttling, leading to performance drops, especially when the battery is low.
  • Adjust Power Settings:
    • Adjusting power settings ensures uninterrupted playback, recording, and USB device operation.
      1. Open Control Panel.
      2. Select Hardware and Sound.
      3. Choose Power Options.
      4. Activate the High Performance plan (click ‘Show additional Plans’ if necessary).
      5. Adjust the High Performance plan settings: set both the display and computer’s sleep times to ‘Never’.
      6. Go to Change advanced power settings. Ensure hard disks don’t sleep, disable USB selective suspend settings, and set minimum processor state to 100%.

  • Disable USB Power Management:
    • Doing this frees up USB bus bandwidth, aiding device recognition and driver installation.
      1. Open Device Manager under Hardware & Sound.
      2. Expand Universal Serial Bus Controllers.
      3. Double-click on each USB Root Hub item, navigate to the Power Management tab, and uncheck “Allow the computer to turn off this device to save power.”

Hard Disk Optimizations

Optimizing your hard disk improves performance during audio playback and recording.

  1. Open File Explorer.
  2. Right-click on the audio storage drive and select Properties.
  3. Ensure ‘Compress this drive to save disk space’ is unchecked.
  4. Repeat for any/all connected hard drives.

Processor Adjustments

Optimizing the processor allows DEX 3 or other PCDJ software to run more efficiently.

  1. Navigate to System > Advanced System Settings > Advanced Tab.
  2. Under Performance, adjust settings to prioritize Background Services.
  3. Restart your computer.

Disable User Account Control

UAC can interfere with volume permissions. To disable:

  1. Open Control Panel and go to User Accounts.
  2. Adjust User Account Control Settings to ‘Never Notify.’
  3. Reboot your computer.

Disable C-State Transition and Turbo Boost (BIOS)

If available, turn off these settings to ensure steady processor speed. Refer to your computer or motherboard manufacturer for guidance.

Updates and Drivers

  • Windows Updates: Keep your OS updated for optimal performance and security.
  • Graphics Driver: Update regularly to prevent your system’s CPU from overloading and decreasing DEX 3 performance.
  • Network Adapter Driver: Keep these updated to ensure optimal software performance.
  • Latest Device Drivers: Update your controller’s drivers regularly to maintain compatibility with DEX 3, DEX 3 RE, or LYRX.
  • PCDJ Software Updates: Make sure you’re running the latest version of PCDJ (Updates include performance improvements and bug fixes). DEX 3 Support | DEX 3 RE Support | LYRX Support

Miscellaneous Optimizations

  1. Directly connect audio interfaces or controllers to your computer instead of using USB hubs or adapters.
  2. Close unnecessary programs to free up resources.
  3. Temporarily turn off background software utilities. If in doubt, consult an IT expert.
  4. Unplug unused USB devices.

Remember to stay updated and periodically check for optimizations for the best performance with DEX 3 , DEX 3 RE , or LYRX .
